newsitem.title: USA: Dawson buys Shenzhen company for $102 mln.
newsitem.headline: Dawson buys Shenzhen company for $102 mln.

text.p: Dawson Science Corp said on Tuesday it acquired all of the shares of Shenzhen City Zhenghua Traffic and Transportation Main Co Ltd, a unit of Shenzhen Zhenghua Co Ltd for about $102.3 million in stock.
Dawson said it paid a combination of common and convertible preferred stocks for Shenzhen City Zhenghua, which owns, operates and leases over 1,000 taxi cabs and trucks in southern China.
The acquisition would add $78.3 million in revenues and about $0.58 per share, the company said.
Wu Zhi Jian would become the major controlling stockholder and president and chief executive officer of the company, Dawson said.
The company said it would continue to look for more acquisition opportunities in Asia.
